exposure: non-surgical treatments (methotrexate, uterine artery embolization, balloon catheter) for Cesarean scar pregnancy
surgical treatments (hysterectomy, hysteroscopy, excision of pregnancy with or without uterine niche repair) for Cesarean scar pregnancy
cohort: Women diagnosed with Cesarean scar pregnancy between 2019 and 2023 at a tertiary university affiliated medical center.
finding: Surgical treatment for Cesarean scar pregnancy led to a significantly faster decrease in b-hCG levels compared to non-surgical treatment, while hospitalization lengths and other immediate outcomes were comparable.
gest_age: Median gestational age at diagnosis was comparable between the non-surgical and surgical treatment groups.
